versions.changelog:
gladia-using-cli v1.0.2

- Removed outdated reference file: skill-card.md.
- Updated references/cli-vs-sdk.md for CLI vs SDK guidance.
- No changes to user-facing CLI instructions or workflow.

- Added explicit support and documentation for transcribing YouTube URLs with Gladia CLI.
- Updated command and usage descriptions to clarify handling of local files, http(s) URLs, and YouTube URLs.
- Removed the obsolete file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of gladia-using-cli skill, providing terminal-based transcription of audio files and URLs via the Gladia CLI.
- Guides when to use CLI vs SDK skills, including feature and workflow differences.
- Documents setup, available commands, key CLI flags, and output format options for transcription.
- Includes agent workflow for capturing and answering questions based only on transcription results.
- Lists key limitations and directs users to alternative skills for live audio, SDK integration, and advanced audio intelligence features.
